reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag fits my day. The launch price of $24.99 and the money-back guarantee make it an easy impulse try if a creator video hits the sleep problem.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and 2 capsules a day for 30 days is still something I have to remember. I'd also want to see the lab report for real before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing the lab report and the QR code actually working, plus less packaging than a foil sachet per day.
